rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is essentially or in effect the case.

example.english: I’m effectively unavailable today, so I’ll go tomorrow.
example.traditional: 其實我今日唔得閒，聽日先去啦。
example.jyutping: kei4 sat6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4 ting1 jat6 sin1 heoi3 laa1

rows.note: Choose this when stressing practical reality rather than simply correcting or qualifying what was said.

example.english: In practical terms, this plan effectively doesn’t help us save money.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃實際上幫唔到我哋慳錢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sat6 zai3 soeng6 bong1 m4 dou2 ngo5 dei6 haan1 cin2

rows.note: Use this for carrying out an action efficiently or in an effective manner.

example.english: You can effectively process the documents.
example.traditional: 你哋可以有效率咁處理啲文件。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jau5 haau6 leot6 gam2 cyu2 lei5 di1 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when effectively means forcefully or with a powerful impact, rather than efficiently.

example.english: We effectively forced the door open and only then got inside.
example.traditional: 我哋大力咁推開道門，先至入到去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daai6 lik6 gam2 teoi1 hoi1 dou6 mun4 sin1 zi3 jap6 dou3 heoi3
